title: Composite suggestion promotion + canonize the demand-driven pen-triage policy
description:
Operator decision 2026-07-20 (Eduardo): the suggestion pen is triaged by TWO rules that compose, neither replacing the other.

(1) PROMOCAO SOB DEMANDA: a pen entry is not promoted eagerly on sight. It stays in scripts/cam/suggestions.jsonl (which is durable, committed to main, so nothing is lost) and is promoted only when a cycle is about to touch the surface it names. This makes the backlog count reflect only work we intend to do, and it makes the grouping decision accurate by construction, since at promotion time the target surface is already known.

(2) COMPOSICAO POR SITIO DE CORRECAO: when promoting, pen entries that share a fix site (same file, same rule, one coherent edit) become ONE issue with composite scope. Entries that merely share a theme, with independent fix sites that could ship in different cycles, stay separate. Shared fate is the underlying test; fix site is the proxy for it.

WHY THIS NEEDS CODE, NOT JUST A DOC. Measured 2026-07-20: `cam suggestions promote` accepts exactly ONE fingerprint (src/commands/suggestions.ts:533, CLI usage line `promote <fingerprint>`). There is no composite path. Composing by hand today means promoting fp1 and dismissing fp2/fp3 -- but terminal-review dedup keys on the `suggestion-fingerprint: <fp>` line embedded in a filed issue's description (suggestions.ts:498), and `dismiss` removes the pen line WITHOUT filing anything. So every hand-composed promotion silently re-arms fp2/fp3 to be re-filed by the next terminal review. Manual composition is not merely tedious, it REGRESSES dedup.

SCOPE:
- `cam suggestions promote <fp1> [<fp2> ...]`: file ONE issue whose description carries a `suggestion-fingerprint:` line for EVERY promoted fingerprint, so dedup holds for all of them, and remove all promoted lines from the pen in ONE atomic on-main commit (preserving the existing commit-tree-to-main pattern and byte-preserving every non-matching pen line). Single-fingerprint invocation must remain byte-identical in behavior to today.
- Composite description must preserve each entry's derivedFrom/sourceIssue provenance, not just the first one's.
- Unknown fingerprint anywhere in the list: error, exit non-zero, mutate NOTHING (all-or-nothing, matching today's single-fp guarantee).
- Canonize the policy in memory/ as a decision file (per the knowledge-layer routing table in scripts/cam/CLAUDE.md: cross-cutting decision / stakeholder policy -> memory/project_<topic>.md).
- Reflect the operative rule in .claude/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md where the orchestrator actually consults it at triage time. CHECK THE DUAL-COPY: .claude/ and templates/ are NOT uniformly byte-identical; diff before assuming an edit forces a re-embed, and run `bun run embed-vendor:check` if templates/ is touched.

NOT AN ADR: this is a triage policy, cheaply reversible, so it fails the ADR hard-to-reverse gate. memory/ is the correct channel.

CONTEXT (measured, for whoever specs this): 43 promotions vs 35 dismissals historically, and 26 of 41 promoted issues (63%) already shipped -- the promotion filter is well calibrated and this issue must NOT tighten it. Intake runs ~2.9 issues/cycle against ~1.4 shipped/cycle; this issue targets the SHAPE of filed issues, not the acceptance bar.

NEEDS REBUILD: touches src/, which the sidecar executes.
